en.baselineVerifyTip: the baseline route is flagged — verify it before comparing
en.cheapestTip: The lowest output price listed in the catalog for this model ({n} providers). Listings, not quotes.
en.confEstimated: provider not matched — cost shown as a {min}–{max} range across candidates
en.confMissing: model not in the pricing catalog
en.divergentTip: Catalog price differs from your route by >10%
en.emptyFilter: No models match the current filters.
en.freeTip: Listed at $0 by this provider (free tier) — excluded from the paid-price comparison
en.leakHint: History re-billed at full input price instead of the cached price, over the shown window. Only routes with resolvable prices are counted; providers without a documented cache TTL fold their expiry leaks into "unattributed". Estimates, not a bill.
en.onlyMineMiss: None of the configured providers ({list}) have priced rows in the catalog — showing all providers
en.overTip: Same model on {n} providers; this route costs {pct}% more (by output price)
en.promoFeedHint: Compiled community feed of active offers; empty string disables promotions.
en.promoPanelHint: Community-contributed offers, verified against the linked source. Not per-token list prices.
en.sessHint: Estimated from local session logs priced against the catalog — an estimate, never a bill.
en.sessWinHint: Only sessions updated within this window are estimated and summed.
en.settingsHint: Controls the pricing table under Settings → Models. Changes apply without a restart.
en.sourceHint: models.dev document the table is built from; applies on the next load.
en.subTip: Flat-rate subscription plan — the listed per-token prices are nominal, not usable rates
en.tagRulesHint: Optional {"extend": …} or {"override": …} rules; leave empty for defaults.
en.title: Model pricing
en.ttlHint: How often the catalog is refetched in the background.
en.verifyTip: Listed under half the official {official} price — verify with the provider before relying on this route
